messages:
maria: FYI customer 'BrightForms' opened a support escalatation — they see a ~18% higher billed tokens on invoice vs dashboard for Feb 27. Says it started right after the partial eventstore outage yesterday. Can someone triage?

sanjay: looking. I can already see a backlog in the ingestion topic around 2026-02-26T23:40Z — consumers were lagging. suspect replay/backfill mismatch + duplicate events. grabbing offsets now.

ops-bot: ALERT: eventstore-partition-7 consumer_lag > 1,000,000 msgs (auto-throttle applied) :warning:

lina: if replay produced duplicates we may have double-counted tokens. quick check: run this to see duplicates by request_id in ledger_events (last 48h):
```sql
SELECT request_id, count(*) AS cnt
FROM ledger_events
WHERE created_at >= '2026-02-25'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

maria: good. also customer attached samples showing same request_id billed twice across two invoice line items. attaching them to the ticket.

james: repro notes — during the outage the replay tool was re-run with start_offset=1001 and end_offset=2000 but our dedupe window was only 24h; original events from earlier replay still within window so they were re-ingested. I'll snapshot current offsets: partition7:[1001-2000], partition8:[500-1500].

sanjay: plan proposal: 1) pause automated replay job for affected partitions, 2) run de-dup reconciliation job to identify exact duplicate request_ids and produce a dedupe manifest, 3) run targeted backfill that uses manifest to skip duplicates, 4) create customer credit estimate and draft rollback invoice. Thoughts?

lina: +1. For (2) use the reconciliation query and output CSV with these headers: partition,offset,request_id,hash. Then use replay-tool --skip-manifest. Example command: 
```bash
./replay-tool --topic events --start 1001 --end 2000 --skip-manifest duplicates.csv --dry-run
```

maria: ops, what's ETA on running reconciliation? we need a customer-facing estimate within 4 hours for support.

ops-bot: runbook triggered: /run metering-reconcile partition=7,8 window=72h (owner: sanjay)

sanjay: starting reconcile now. rough ETA 2h to generate manifest, +1h to re-run dry-run backfill. If dry-run shows no extra token increments we can schedule controlled backfill overnight.

billing-bot: NOTE: Refund pipeline requires a confirmed delta and accounting approval. Please attach estimated token delta (integer) and affected invoice IDs when ready.

maria: will do — I'll draft the customer note: apologize, explain root cause (duplicate replay during outage), outline mitigation and provisional credit.

james: one more mitigation: add tighter dedupe window check in replay-controller to consult ledger_event checksums before re-ingesting — I'll open a PR after triage.

lina: putting checklist in the ticket: snapshot offsets, reconcile duplicates, dry-run backfill, controlled backfill with skip-manifest, compute token delta, billing approval, customer communication.

maria: thanks. I'll keep support and the customer updated. tagging @billing-bot and @ops-bot for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
